DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの明細について、お尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the statement you have with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ATMから出た紙の文字が薄くて読めません。もう一度同じ操作をすれば、読みやすい紙が出ると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薄い明細を得直すため同じATM操作を再実行しかけたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The writing on the slip from the ATM is too faint to read. I thought repeating the same operation would give me a readable slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you nearly repeated the same ATM operation to obtain a replacement for a faintly printed statement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 印字の確認と、同じ取引をもう一度行うことは別です。どの部分が読めませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Checking the printing and carrying out the same transaction again are different things. Which part can you not read?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 金額の欄です。紙が読みにくいだけなのか、操作が終わっていないのか分からなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 金額欄が読めず紙の不鮮明と取引未完了を混同したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The amount field. I became unsure whether only the slip was hard to read or the transaction had not finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you could not read the amount field and confused unclear printing with an incomplete transaction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 紙を拝見し、取引の確認方法を担当がご案内します。今は同じ操作を繰り返さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: A staff member will look at the slip and explain how to check the transaction. Please do not repeat the operation now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 繰り返していません。紙を出す目的で、同じ取引を重ねてしまわないように相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 操作未反復で再取引による重複を避け相談に来たと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not repeated it. I came for advice so that I would not duplicate the transaction just to get a slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you have not repeated the operation and came for advice to avoid a duplicate transaction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用した機械と、おおよその時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know which machine you used and roughly what time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口側の機械で、昼前です。この紙を見て時刻を読んだのではなく、使ったときの記憶です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 機械位置と記憶時刻を伝え明細読取時刻とは区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The machine by the entrance, before noon. That is my memory of using it, not a time I read from this slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the machine's location and the time you remember, distinguishing it from a time read on the statement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点も担当へお伝えください。読めない欄は推測で書き足さずお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the staff member that too. Bring the slip without guessing and filling in the unreadable fields.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 紙はそのまま見せます。薄い欄を自分で数字に直さず、既存の取引がどうなったか確認してから考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 明細を改変せず既存取引の確認後に次の行動を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the slip as it is. I will not turn the faint fields into numbers myself; I will check what happened to the existing transaction before deciding what to do.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not alter the statement; decide your next action after checking the existing transaction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 既存の取引の確認として承ります。それでは、担当へどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will handle this as a check of the existing transaction. Please see the staff member. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのパンをいくつもお選びですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you choosing several of these breads?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 絵の練習で、何日か同じ形を見て描きたいです。食べる予定はなく、模型として買おうと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 複数パンを数日の写生模型として買い食べる予定はないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to draw the same shapes over several days for drawing practice. I do not plan to eat them; I thought of buying them as models.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to buy several breads as drawing models for several days and do not plan to eat them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食品ですので、何日も模型の状態で使えるというご案内はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: These are food products, so we cannot tell you they can be used as models for days.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 食べるまでの表示を、形を保てる期間だと思っていました。描くための保証ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 食品表示が模型形状保持の保証でないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the information about when to eat them meant how long they would retain their shape. It is not a guarantee for drawing, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that food labeling does not guarantee that the bread will retain its shape as a model. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。食品の表示をご覧いただき、購入の目的もお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please read the food labeling and consider your purpose for buying them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は模型用にまとめて買うのをやめます。食べる分の一つだけを選び、描く対象は別に考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 模型用まとめ買いを止め食べる一つだけを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not buy a batch for models today. I will choose just one to eat and think of something else to draw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Stop the bulk purchase for models and choose just one to eat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身で食べる品物は、どちらにされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Which one would you like to eat yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この小さいパンにします。家で食べる前に短く描くかもしれませんが、長く置くための物とは扱いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 食前の短い写生はしても長期模型保存目的としない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: This small bread. I may draw it briefly before eating it at home, but I will not treat it as something to keep for a long time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you may sketch it briefly before eating, but will not keep it as a long-term model. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの表示もご確認ください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示を見ました。描き終わるまで食べる時期を延ばすのではなく、絵の予定を自分で変えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食品表示を確認し食べる時期より絵の予定を変える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have read the label. Instead of postponing eating until I finish drawing, I will change my drawing plans myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the food labeling and change your drawing plans rather than the time for eating. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの一つで承ります。それでは、レジへどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take just this one. Please go to the register. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 将棋の交流会を見にいらっしゃいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you come to watch the shogi gathering?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。興味はありますが、駒の動きを全部覚えていません。いきなり相手を待たせるのが心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 将棋への興味と駒の動きの不確かさで対局をためらうと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am interested, but I have not learned how all the pieces move. I worry about keeping an opponent waiting straight away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are interested in shogi but hesitate to play because you are unsure how the pieces move. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず一局を観戦してみることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can start by watching a game.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 観戦から始めたいです。分からない駒があったら、対局中に動かして確かめてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 観戦開始を希望し未知の駒を盤上で動かしてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to start by watching. If there is a piece I do not understand, may I move it during the game to check?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to start by watching and whether you may move an unfamiliar piece on the board. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対局中の盤には触れず、休憩のときに係へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not touch the board during a game; ask a staff member during the break.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。動きを見て、質問したい駒の名前を自分のメモに残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 進行盤に触れず質問する駒名を自分のメモに記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will watch the moves and write the names of pieces I want to ask about in my own notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not touch the board in play; record the names of pieces you want to ask about in your own notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 勝敗だけでなく、どの手を見たいか意識して観戦してもよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You might watch with a particular move in mind, rather than just who wins or loses.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は、同じ駒がどう進んだかを一つ追ってみます。全部の手をすぐ覚えるつもりでなく、気になった所を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 全手暗記でなく同じ駒の動きを一つ追って疑問を持つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Today I will follow how one particular piece moves. I do not intend to memorize every move immediately; I want to ask about what catches my attention.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Follow the movement of one piece and note questions, rather than memorizing every move. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 休憩になりましたら、練習用の盤で係がご相談を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: During the break, a staff member can answer your questions at a practice board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この一局は最後まで見ます。休憩時に一つ質問し、その後で練習するかを決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一局観戦後の休憩で質問しその後の練習参加を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will watch this game to the end. I will ask one question during the break and then decide whether to practice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After watching a game, ask a question during the break, then decide whether to join practice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その参加方法で結構です。それでは、観戦をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: That way of participating is fine. Enjoy watching.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 携帯の切符をお見せになるところでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you about to show your ticket on your phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。端末が開かないので、切符の購入も失敗したと思いかけています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 端末が開かず切符購入も失敗と疑ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My device will not unlock, so I almost thought the ticket purchase had failed too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your device will not unlock and you suspected the ticket purchase had failed too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 開かないのは、切符の画面ですか。それとも端末そのものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is it the ticket screen that will not open, or the device itself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 端末そのものです。手袋をしたまま指紋の確認をしていました。切符の画面までは進めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手袋で端末認証を試し切符画面まで未到達と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The device itself. I was trying fingerprint verification with my gloves on. I have not reached the ticket screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you tried device authentication with gloves on and have not reached the ticket screen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 端末の操作はご自身でご確認ください。いま切符を買い直す前に、購入した内容も確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check your device's operation yourself. Before buying another ticket now, let us also check what you purchased.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に脇へ移って、自分で手袋を外し端末を確認します。端末の番号を係員へ伝えて開けてもらうつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 脇で本人が端末を確認し番号を係員へ渡す解除は頼まない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will step aside first, remove my gloves, and check the device myself. I do not intend to give the attendant my device code and ask them to unlock it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the device yourself at the side; do not ask an attendant to unlock it by giving them your code. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この位置でお待ちいただけます。切符を表示できたらお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may wait here. Please let me know when you can display the ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分で開けました。購入済みの切符が出ているので、別の切符は買いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人解除後に購入済み券を表示でき再購入しないと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I unlocked it myself. The ticket I already purchased is displayed, so I will not buy another one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that you unlocked it yourself, displayed the purchased ticket, and will not buy it again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それでは、表示された切符を拝見します。画面をご自身でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I will check the displayed ticket. Please hold the screen yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この画面です。指紋の確認ができないことと、切符がないことを同じだと思わず、順に確かめられました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人保持の画面を提示し端末認証と券の有無を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here is the screen. I was able to check things in order without treating failed fingerprint verification as meaning I had no ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the screen while holding it yourself and distinguish device authentication from whether you have a ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 表示を確認しますので、こちらへお進みください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please come this way so I can check the display. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご意見の欄に書く内容でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble deciding what to write in the comments field?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 経緯を全部書いたら、欄からはみ出しました。小さい字にすれば読んでもらえるかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 意見の経緯が欄に収まらず極小文字で書こうとしたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I wrote the whole background, it went outside the field. I thought they might read it if I wrote in tiny letters.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the background to your comment would not fit and you considered writing in extremely small letters. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、いちばん伝えたい点を短く整理できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you first briefly organize the main point you want to convey?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 歩道の案内が見えにくいので、表示を見直してほしいということです。細かい経緯と同じ長さで書く必要はないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 困り事と求める表示見直しを要点として述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The sidewalk directions are hard to see, so I want the signage reviewed. I do not need to write as much about that as about all the background details, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the problem and your requested review of the signage as the main points. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 要点の説明と、詳しい経緯を分けてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us separate the main point from the detailed background.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 要点はこの欄へ書きます。経緯を別紙にしたいのですが、添えてよいかを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 要点を欄に書き詳しい経緯を別紙にできるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will write the main point in this field. I would like to put the background on a separate sheet, but want to check whether I may attach it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Write the main point in the field and ask whether you may put the detailed background on another sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別紙の受付方法は担当へ確認します。いま必ず添えられると決めず、ご準備ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check with the staff member how separate sheets are accepted. Please prepare it without assuming you can definitely attach it now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 内容を別に整理しておきます。文字数を減らすため、何が困ったかまで消さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 添付未確認のまま準備し困り事自体は削らない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will organize the content separately. I will make sure I do not remove the actual problem just to reduce the character count.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prepare it while attachment remains unconfirmed, and do not remove the problem itself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人が伝えたいこととして、短い説明を読み返してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please reread the short explanation to ensure it conveys what you yourself want to say.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 困った点と希望する見直しを残して読み返しました。別紙の扱いを聞いてから、提出する形を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 要点を読み返して別紙受付確認後に提出形を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I reread it with the problem and the requested review retained. I will decide the submission format after asking how the separate sheet is handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reread the main points and decide the submission format after checking whether a separate sheet is accepted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 要点が整理できましたね。それでは、別紙の扱いを担当へお尋ねください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have organized the main points. Please ask the staff member how to handle the separate sheet. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の記入で、お手伝いが必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need help filling in the medical questionnaire?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手が使いづらくて、文字を書けません。用紙を空けたままで出す前に、代筆を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手が使いづらく未記入票を出す前に代筆支援を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My hands are difficult to use and I cannot write. Before handing in the form blank, I would like to ask about someone writing for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that using your hands is difficult and you want writing assistance before submitting an unfilled form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 記入の支援について担当へ確認します。内容はご自身でお答えになれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check with the staff member about help filling it in. Can you answer the questions yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 答えられます。代わりに書く方が状態を推測するのではなく、私の答えを記入してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人が回答可能で代筆者に状態を推測してほしくないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I would like whoever writes for me to record my answers, rather than guess my condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you can answer yourself and do not want the person writing to guess your condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのご希望を伝えます。記入した内容は、ご本人にも確かめていただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will pass on your request. You will also be asked to check what has been written.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 読んで確認できます。自分で書いていないからと、全部正しく入ったと思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人が読めるので代筆内容も確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can read and check it. I will not assume everything was entered correctly just because someone else wrote it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you can read and will also check what someone writes for you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書いていない欄について、理由を伝えておきたい所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are there any unfilled fields whose reason you would like to explain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この欄は答えが分からないので空いています。手が使いづらくて書けなかった欄と、理由が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不明で空けた欄と身体的に書けなかった欄を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: This field is blank because I do not know the answer. That is different from the fields I could not fill in because my hands are difficult to use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish fields left blank because you do not know the answer from those you physically could not fill in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分からない欄も、担当へそのままご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also discuss the fields you do not understand with the staff member as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 理由を分けて伝えます。答えられる部分は私が話し、記入後に内容を確かめてから出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 空欄理由を分け本人回答と記入後確認を経て提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain the reasons separately. I will speak the answers I can give and submit the form after checking what was entered.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the different reasons for blanks, answer yourself, and check the completed entries before submitting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 代筆のご相談と空欄の理由を担当へ伝えます。それでは、こちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell the staff member about your request for writing assistance and the reasons for the blanks. Please wait here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 最後にかばんを確かめた場所を、地図で示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Can you show on the map where you last checked your bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このピンの場所です。地図が開いたので、ここにいた時だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 開いた地図のピンを最後に荷物を見た場所として示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is where this pin is. The map opened, so I thought that was where I was at the time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Indicate the pin on the opened map as the last place you saw your belongings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ピンは、ご自身のいた場所として付けた物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you place the pin to mark somewhere you had been?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、行く予定の店へ付けた物でした。まだ着いていない所を、最後に見た場所として示してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ピンは未到着の目的店で本人の目撃記録でないと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I placed it on a shop I planned to visit. I indicated a place I had not reached as where I last saw it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct yourself: the pin is the intended shop you had not reached, not a record of your own sighting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 目的地と、実際に確認した場所を分けて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish your destination from where you actually checked the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: かばんを持っていたのは、途中で座ったベンチです。店へ向かう前に立ち寄りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 途中のベンチで荷物を確認し目的店前に寄ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I had my bag at a bench where I sat along the way. I stopped there before heading to the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you checked your belongings at a bench on the way, where you stopped before the destination shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ベンチの場所は、この地図で分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you locate the bench on this map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この辺りだと思いますが、正確な位置はまだ分かりません。目的地のピンを動かして正確な印に見せるのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ベンチ位置は曖昧でピン移動による正確な印を装わない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I think it is around here, but I still do not know the exact location. I will not move the destination pin to make it look like a precise marker.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the bench location is uncertain and do not pretend a moved pin is an exact marker. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かる目印や、覚えている移動もお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell us about landmarks you know and the route you remember too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ベンチの横に案内板がありました。その目印と通った順番を話し、店の住所で紛失場所を埋めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 覚えた目印と移動順を話し目的店住所で不明位置を埋めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: There was an information board beside the bench. I will describe that landmark and the order of my route, without filling the unknown loss location with the shop's address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe remembered landmarks and the order of your route; do not fill in an unknown location with the destination shop's address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 目的地と記憶を分けて記録します。それでは、担当へご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will record the destination separately from your memories. I will take you to the staff member. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらを一緒に発送されるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to send these together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。私の本と、知人から預かった小さい袋です。袋は閉じてありますが、本に挟めるくらいなので紙だけだと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本と封済み知人袋を同梱し小ささから紙と推測したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My books and a small bag an acquaintance asked me to hold. The bag is sealed, but it is small enough to fit between the books, so I think it only contains paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you intend to pack your books with an acquaintance's sealed bag and inferred it contained paper because it was small. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 預かった袋の中身は、知人の方に確かめられていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked the bag's contents with your acquaintance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 確かめていません。中身を見ていないので、私の本と同じ物として説明するのは違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 他者袋の中身未確認で自分の本と同じ説明にしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I have not seen inside, so it would be wrong to describe it as the same thing as my books.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the other person's bag is unchecked and do not describe it as the same as your books. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中の物が分かってから、発送の条件をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please discuss the shipping conditions once you know what is inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 知人へ聞きます。ここで袋を開けてよいかも頼まれていないので、勝手に破りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人へ確認し開封了解もない袋を勝手に破らない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask my acquaintance. They have not asked me to open the bag here either, so I will not tear it open without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check with the owner and do not tear open a bag without permission to open it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本日、確認できているお荷物だけの相談をされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you like advice today only about the items whose contents you have confirmed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、自分の本だけで相談したいです。知人の袋は別に持って帰り、確認後に一緒にするか考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日は本だけ相談し知人袋は持帰って同梱を再検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I would like advice about just my books. I will take the acquaintance's bag home separately and consider sending them together after checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about only the books today, take the acquaintance's bag home, and reconsider packing together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それでは、本のお荷物はこちらへお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then please put your package of books here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本だけを出します。小さいから紙だという判断をやめ、知人の品は確認前の発送に混ぜません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本のみ提示して未確認の預り品を発送に混ぜない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put out only the books. I will stop assuming it is paper because it is small and will not include my acquaintance's items in the shipment before checking them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Present only the books and do not include unchecked items entrusted to you in the shipment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本のお荷物についてご案内します。それでは、こちらへどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will explain shipping your books. Please come this way. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 毎月の収入として書かれた金額を、確認してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I check the amount you entered as monthly income?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 給与と、家族からもらった祝い金を足しました。今月は両方入ったので、この金額で毎月の計画を作っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与と当月祝い金の合計で毎月計画を作ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I added my salary and the congratulatory money my family gave me. I received both this month, so I am using this amount to plan every month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you made monthly plans using the total of your salary and this month's congratulatory gift. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 祝い金も、毎月受け取るご予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you expect to receive the congratulatory money every month too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、引っ越しのお祝いで一度もらいました。来月も同じ額が来るという約束はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 祝い金は一回で翌月同額の約束がないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I received it once as a housewarming gift. There is no promise that the same amount will come next month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the gift was one-time and the same amount has not been promised for next month. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 繰り返し受け取る金額と、今回だけの金額を分けてお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell us separately the amounts you receive regularly and the amount for this occasion only.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 給与の欄と、今回の祝い金の欄を分けます。家族に次も払うと約束してもらったようには説明しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 定期給与と今回受取を分け家族の継続約束を装わない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will separate the salary field from this gift's field. I will not explain it as though my family promised to pay again next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate regular salary from this receipt and do not imply your family promised continuing payments. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今月の受取り自体は、確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you confirmed that you actually received it this month?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認できています。受け取った事実は消さず、毎月続くと思っていた部分を直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受領事実は確認済みとして保ち繰返しの解釈を修正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will retain the fact that I received it and correct the part where I thought it would continue every month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Retain the confirmed fact of receipt and correct your interpretation that it would recur. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今後の計画は、分けた情報で担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please consult the adviser about future plans using the separated information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一度きりの分を来月の収入の根拠にしないようにします。今月の受取りと、続く収入を分けて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 単発受取を翌月根拠にせず情報を分け家計相談をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not use the one-time amount as grounds for next month's income. I will discuss this month's receipts separately from continuing income.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not use a one-time receipt as grounds for next month's income; separate the information when discussing your household budget. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その区別を相談担当へお伝えください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please explain that distinction to the adviser. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 食材の名前の読み方をお尋ねになりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ask how to read an ingredient's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、この名前を読めません。家で話す時にも困るので、読み方を自分のメモに足したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 読めない食材漢字を家庭でも言えるよう自分のメモに読みを足したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I cannot read this name. It is also difficult when talking at home, so I want to add its pronunciation to my own notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to add the reading of the ingredient's unfamiliar kanji to your own notes so you can say it at home too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身のメモをお持ちでしたら、こちらの表示と一緒に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you have your own notes, we can check them together with this label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: メモがあります。売場の札に私が読みを書き足すのではなく、この紙へ書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 売場札を改変せず本人用紙へ書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my notes. I will write on this paper, rather than add my own pronunciation to the shop's label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will write on your own paper without altering the shop's label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品名の「小松菜」は、「こまつな」と読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The product name, written with the characters for small, pine, and greens, is pronounced “komatsuna.”

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こまつなですね。名前の漢字も写して、読みだけの別の商品と混ざらないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小松菜とこまつなの対応を漢字と読みで記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Komatsuna, then. I will copy its kanji too so I do not confuse it with another product noted only by pronunciation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Record the correspondence between komatsuna's written characters and its pronunciation using both. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日は、この商品をお求めですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you like to buy this product today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は一袋買いたいです。次回自分で探すために、メモには商品名と読みを並べて残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日一袋購入し次回探索用に名称と読みを並べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like one bag today. I will keep the product name beside its pronunciation in my notes so I can find it myself next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Buy one bag today and note the name beside its pronunciation to find it next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 量やお値段は、そのときの品物と表示でお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the quantity and price against the actual product and label on each occasion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 次回の値段まで同じとは書きません。今日の名前と読みを覚え、一袋の表示を見て会計へ持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 次回価格を固定せず今日の品の表示を確認して会計へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not write that even next time's price will be the same. I will remember today's name and pronunciation, check the label for one bag, and take it to the register.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not fix next time's price; check today's product label and proceed to payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご自身のメモができましたね。それでは、お買物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your own notes are ready. Enjoy your shopping.
